references.text: Daberath is mentioned again as a Levitical city in the territory of the tribe of Issachar
Daberath is listed as one of the Levitical cities given to the Gershonite clan from the tribe of Issachar
Mount Tabor, where Kishloth-Tabor is located, is the place where Barak gathered his forces to fight against Sisera
Mount Tabor was the starting point for Barak's attack on Sisera's army
Kishloth-Tabor and the area around Mount Tabor were well-known territory in Israel's history
Tabor is mentioned along with other mountains as a witness to God's greatness
